create_fastspeech2_criterion: create a FastSpeech2Loss criterion instance with a configurable CTC weight for training
compute_fastspeech2_loss: compute the combined L1, duration, pitch, energy, and CTC loss for a FastSpeech2 model forward pass
reduce_fastspeech2_metrics: reduce per-batch logging outputs into weighted aggregate metrics for loss components and inference ratios
configure_ctc_weight: configure the CTC loss weight in FastSpeech2CriterionConfig to enable or disable CTC regularization
review_fastspeech2_loss_forward: review the FastSpeech2Loss forward method to understand how feature, pitch, energy, and duration losses are computed
